also hone, grindstone, sharpening stone

classical

cōs, cōtis f.

noun, third declension

a whetstone; any hard stone

Akin to cautēs, a crag. In the plural also hard rocks (Verg. E. 8.43).

See also knife, sickle, axe, crag, flint.
